Which kinda goes back again to...have you looked? The Resources section (linked above) has a pinned directory thread that lists tons of threads by type of resource, including battler. There are certainly different styles represented, but many of them are RTP edits or drawn to be compatible with the RTP.
It also goes back to what
@Ms Littlefish
said -
what
are you looking for? Logic dictates that looking for something broad like "monsters" is going to give you an unusable number of results.
If you say more specifically "I'm looking for a spider" or something, that gives you something you can search for and get concrete results.
As for music, there are also music threads in there; there are several people who post in their free music threads here every few days, it's hard to imagine you could come on the site and look at recent posts and
not
see them.

For music, there are quite a few threads in General Resources.
